raw:
Robert Kubica won one Grand Prix while driving for BMW Sauber: the 2008 Canadian Grand Prix at Circuit Gilles Villeneuve, where he started 2nd and finished first. The search results show no other BMW Sauber win for him. His other BMW Sauber results in the retrieved reports were all placings behind the winner (for example, 2nd in Japan 2008 and 3rd in Valencia 2008), so I found no other victories.

ANSWER: 1
